description: A sixteen-step sequencer laid out as a four-by-four grid, stepped by triggers that move the playhead in a chosen direction

params.text: Starts and stops the sequencer; the outputs rest while it is stopped
Moves the playhead to the top left cell
Sets the voltage that cell sends, from 0V to the ceiling set by the RANGE knob
Turns the gate for that cell on or off
Sets every voltage knob at random
Sets the root note the pitch output is quantised to
Sets the scale the pitch output is quantised to; the last setting leaves the pitch alone
Turns the gates on and off at random
Moves the playhead one cell to the right
Moves the playhead one cell to the left
Moves the playhead one cell down
Moves the playhead one cell up
Moves the playhead one cell in a direction picked at random
Holds the playhead where it is and sends that cell out again
Sets the highest voltage a step knob can reach, 0V to 10V, which is how wide the pitch spread is
Shifts the pitch output by whole octaves, -5 to +7
How likely that cell's gate is to fire, from never at the bottom of its travel to every time at the top
Sets every probability knob at random

inputs.text: A trigger here moves the playhead to the top left cell
A trigger here moves the playhead one cell to the right
A trigger here moves the playhead one cell to the left
A trigger here moves the playhead one cell down
A trigger here moves the playhead one cell up
A trigger here holds the playhead where it is and sends that cell out again
A trigger here moves the playhead one cell in a direction picked at random
A trigger here sets every voltage knob at random
A trigger here turns the gates on and off at random
Added to the RANGE knob, volt for volt
Added to the ROOT knob, 0V to 10V covering the twelve notes
Added to the SCALE knob, 0V to 10V covering every scale
Added to the OCTAVE knob, a volt per octave
A trigger here sets every probability knob at random
A voltage here seeds the random number generator, so the same voltage always gives the same result from a randomise

outputs.text: The gate of the cell the playhead is on
The pitch of the cell the playhead is on, quantised to the root and scale
The gate of the cell opposite the playhead, the one its row and column swapped points to
The pitch of the cell opposite the playhead, the one its row and column swapped points to

notes: the playhead moves only when one of the direction buttons is pressed or a trigger arrives at one of the direction inputs; there is no clock input
menu: Gate Mode — sets what the gate outputs do: Trigger fires a short pulse, Retrigger drops the gate for a moment before each new step, Continuous holds it until the next clock tick
Ignore Gate for V/OCT Out — keeps the pitch output following the sequence even on steps whose gate is off
Select Pattern — sets the path off the edge of the grid: Row Wrap (Stay Row), Row-Major, Column-Major, Snake Rows, Snake Columns, Snake Diagonal Down-Right, Snake Diagonal Up-Right
Gate Length — sets how long a Trigger or Retrigger gate lasts, in milliseconds
